tools.name: browse_category

tools.name: get_app_reviews
tools.description: Get user reviews of an app: star rating, date, text and app version; on Google Play also helpful votes and the developer's reply, on the App Store a review title. Use it to summarize what users like or complain about.

tools.name: get_app_privacy
tools.description: Get an app's privacy information. tools.description: List the apps published by one developer. Google Play: by developer name as returned by other tools (e.g. "Wikimedia Foundation"). App Store: by developer_id from get_app or search_apps with store=app_store (a developer name also works; it is looked up by search).

tools.name: list_my_sites

tools.name: get_site
tools.description: Details of one of your sites: its app, theme, page URLs, whether each page is filled in, and its app-ads.txt records.

tools.name: check_subdomain

tools.name: create_site
tools.description: Create a website for a published app at {subdomain}.apppage.net, filled from its store listing (name, icon, screenshots, description, store buttons). Its privacy policy, terms, account deletion and support pages start empty: write them with set_page. Check the address with check_subdomain first.

tools.name: update_site
tools.description: Change the design (theme) of one of your sites.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read the current HTML of one of your site's pages: privacy_policy, terms, delete_account or support.

tools.name: generate_page
tools.description: Make one of your site's pages from AppPage.net's templates, the same ones as its privacy policy, terms, account deletion and support page generators: fixed, store-ready English text where each answer turns whole sections on or off. Write it in Markdown (default) or HTML; scripts, forms and event handlers are removed. Base

tools.description: Re-read the site's app from Google Play or the App Store now (name, icon, screenshots, description, what's new). Fields the store sends empty keep their current value. Once a minute per site.

tools.name: get_modules
tools.description: Which extras one of your sites has turned on (feedback board, bug reports, beta sign-up, promo codes, remote config, changelog, press kit, status page) with their URLs, its remote config, open status incidents, the latest changelog entries and its App Links files.

Their settings

tools.description: Add a release to your site's public changelog (and its RSS feed). Give version and notes, or from_store=true to add the store listing's current version and What's new. Turns the changelog on if it's off.

tools.name: post_status_incident
tools.description: Post an incident on your site's status page, e.g. an outage or planned maintenance. Turns the status page on if it's off. Apps reading app-config.json can show it too.

tools.name: resolve_status_incident
tools.description: Mark an incident on your site's status page as resolved. get_modules lists the open incidents and their ids.

tools.description: Change the remote config your app reads from https://{site}/app-config.json: the lowest supported and latest versions per platform (apps below the lowest must update), the update message, maintenance mode and an in-app notice. tools.description: Your AppPage.net plan (Free or Pro), what it includes and how much of today's API limit is used.

tools.name: set_custom_domain
tools.description: Serve one of your sites on your own domain, such as www.myapp.com (Pro). Returns the DNS record to add; the domain works once the record is in place and the certificate is issued. Call it again with the same domain to check progress.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_app, get_app_reviews, get_site, get_page, get_modules, get_feedback · Private data: get_app, get_site, generate_page, set_page, set_app_ads_txt, get_modules, set_app_links, set_custom_domain · Public sink: get_app, generate_page, set_page, post_status_incident, get_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_app, get_app_reviews, get_site, get_page, get_modules, get_feedback · Private data: get_app, get_site, generate_page, set_page, set_app_ads_txt, get_modules, set_app_links, set_custom_domain · Public sink: get_app, generate_page, set_page, post_status_incident, get_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
